translations.web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
translations.bsb: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
translations.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
translations.asv: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.
